Eliminating the vertical parameter forces an open angular arc of length pi-pi/n containing at most floor(n/2) equally spaced vertices. Every consecutive block of that maximal size is achieved using an explicitly nonempty delta interval. Integer layerwise partitions and fractional cyclic averaging meet matching lower bounds. Vertex coverage implies boundary coverage by inclusion of active facets. The extracted standard-library checker passed 143208 numeric regression checks for n=3..80 and h=0.1,1,3; numerical checks only supplement the quantified algebraic proof.
